description:
List the calling key's most recently generated PDF reports: type, byte size, page count, language, created/expiry timestamps and a `url`. Re-fetch a report link while it lives (24 h, or the `retain_days` the report was made with), or surface recent exports in a dashboard. PDFs are purged after 24h, so older items return `expired: true` with a now-dead URL. Free to call. Query `?limit=` (1–50, default 10).

[Group: Reports]
[Endpoint: GET /v1/reports/history]
[Cost: see your plan — endpoint not in the public credit manifest]
name: astroway_reports_history
title: List Recent Report Exports
